Next set is yours

We are surfing obsessed, and we invite you to join us.

The lodge sits in the green of the jungle. We run surf weeks for three levels, from your first wave to carving, and a Freestylers package for independent travellers.

One price, three levels

The three surf weeks cost the same, per person for seven nights. That is the base price the booking engine showed on 28 September 2026. The room you choose can add to it; the engine shows any supplement once you pick your dates.

Packages start on a Saturday and run for 7, 14, 21 or 28 nights, for up to six guests per booking. Drinking water and local coffee and tea are unlimited.

ISA-certified surf guides

See the weekly surf packages and dates→ Ask on WhatsApp Call +972 9-973-3943

Footwear is discouraged. Chilling out is inescapable.

Surf, breakfast, surf again

Head out with your group for a morning surf. Back at the lodge, a big, healthy breakfast is waiting.

After that the day is yours: relax at the lodge, or go out and explore before the afternoon surf. The evening ends with dinner, together with the other guests.

Twelve rooms, one big family

There are just twelve rooms. That keeps a stay here personal, part of one big happy family. Every room has air conditioning, a ceiling fan, a safe box, a private toilet and shower, a socket next to each bed and, of course, a board rack.

When you're not on the water, lie out on a sunbed by the pool under the palms, hang out in the common area, take an ice-cold drink from the bar, or eat Sri Lankan produce from the lodge kitchen.

What guests say

Booking.com guests score the staff 9.5 out of 10, and the facilities and the cleanliness 9.2 each.

In their reviews they write about the pool area, the open-air bathroom and the breakfast bowls.

“We loved the cozy, bohoo-vibes at the lodge: starting from the open-air-bathroom, the relaxing pool area and especially the great breakfast bowls!”

Fanny, Germany · Booking.com

“A lovely hotel and a team of champions. Ariel, a professional surf guide, raised the level of surfing for us by several steps during the week we were there. This is our second time at the same hotel and with the same guide. We will return next year as well”

Seagallas · globalsurf.com

“This place felt like something inbetween a hostel and a luxurious hotel. The styling was gorgeous, the beds very comfortable, the (bath)room very spacious with lockers and personal storage space.”

Myrthe, Netherlands · Booking.com

“The room was modern, quiet and incredibly clean with daily servicing. The grounds were well kept with a gorgeous pool and dining area. There are hammocks, loungers and beanbags in social areas. It was a really really great place.”

Abigail, Myanmar · Booking.com

“Super nice place, beautiful rooms, nice hangout area with pool and pillows and delicious breakfast!”

“We stayed at Global Kablana Sri Lanka as a couple and two girls and it was just fun and lovely. The atmosphere, the rooms, the stunning staff. Just everything.”

Dana Amsalem-Cohen · globalsurf.com

Getting here

Booking.com puts Kathaluwa West Beach 40 m from the lodge and Kabalana Beach 350 m. Kathaluwa station is 400 m away, Ahangama Beach 4 km and Koggala Airport 3.9 km.

The lodge overlooks two spots, The Rock and South Point. More waves are a few minutes away by tuk-tuk.
